description_en: Invokes DetachClassicLinkVpc to disconnect a classic network type ECS instance from a virtual private cloud (VPC) by removing the ClassicLink connection. After the ClassicLink connection is removed, the classic network type instance cannot communicate with instances in the VPC
description_zh: 调用DetachClassicLinkVpc取消一台经典网络类型ECS实例与专有网络VPC的连接（ClassicLink）。取消ClassicLink后，经典网络类型实例无法与VPC内的实例互通
kebab_example: aliyun ecs detach-classic-link-vpc --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id i-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --vpc-id vpc-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DetachClassicLinkVpc

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the instance. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 实例所属的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the classic network type instance
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the VPC to which the instance is connected
parameters.name: vpc_id
